findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The soda dispenser nozzles of the soda machine in the lobby area were observed to have significant filth accumulation. PIC was notified and nozzles were cleaned and reinstalled during the inspection to correct the violation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: 1) Both vents of the ceiling in the storage area was observed to have excessive dust accumulation. 2) Also observed was a spot on the ceiling near the mop sink area that seemed to have been soiled from a previous splash. The PIC was made aware cleaning should be conducted prior to the next routine inspection and maintained.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed 3 door cooler to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC, cooler will be cleaned. Ensure facility is cleaning non food contact surfaces at a frequency that prevents food accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(Repeatx2) Observed the following physical facility areas in need of repairs:
1. Multiple areas of the facility need re-caulked: the prep sink in the back, the back triple sink, and the mop sink. All areas have black mold present. 
2.Liner on shelving unit next to the triple sink is broken and has holes. Replace liner. 
3. The wall paper in the women’s bathroom is severely fraying in multiple places. Wall paper needs resealed or replaced. Walls should be smooth and easily cleanable. 

Discussed with PIC, repairs will be made. Ensure physical facility is being monitored at a frequency that prevents the need for physical facility repairs.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.
